channel.title: CarExpert Pty Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CarExpert Pty Ltd (carexpert.com.au)

item.title: Mazda engineers built a V6-powered MX-5 decades ago
item.description: Although it proved to be a dead end, Mazda's European arm briefly toyed with a V6-powered MX-5 two decades ago.

item.title: Iveco working to regain customer confidence
item.description: Product reliability, customer support, and keeping running costs low are all part of a strategy by Iveco to improve its reputation among buyers.

item.title: Chery says more to come from petrol and diesel engine development
item.description: While rivals stopped developing internal combustion engines in the move to EVs, Chery kept working on them – and says it was the right move.

item.title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz C300 AMG Line Plus Edition: Sportier styling, lower price
item.description: For a limited time, Mercedes-Benz is offering its C300 with a sportier look inside and out for $94,900 drive-away, though a few recently added features have been removed.

item.title: Australia's new vehicle emissions regulations delivering results, says Bowen
item.description: The first fall in emissions from the transport sector since COVID has the government claiming the New Vehicle Efficiency Standard is working.

item.title: Luxury Ford to fight Mercedes-Benz G-Wagen – report
item.description: Ford’s premium arm Lincoln is said to be eyeing up the G-Wagen, with plans for a boxy, luxurious off-roader to be based on the Bronco.

item.title: Mini celebrates historic rally win with special edition Cooper JCW
item.description: Mini is paying tribute to one of its many historical rally wins with a very limited edition version of its Cooper JCW hot hatch.

item.title: 2026 Geely EX5 Extended Range price and specs leaked
item.description: The Geely EX5 is set to get a boost in range, but leaked pricing indicates the mid-size electric SUV will also cop a modest price increase.

item.title: 2026 GWM Tank 300 price and specs
item.description: The GWM Tank 300 has a new plug-in hybrid powertrain that matches the rest of the range on towing capacity, and adds a new tow mode.

item.title: 2026 Toyota HiLux-based Fortuner spied, still no-go for Australia
item.description: An Australian-designed front end looks set for the next Toyota Fortuner, but the automaker says it won't be sold here.
